text: The first official international football match was played in 1872 between Scotland and England, ending in a 0-0 draw.
Brazil is the only national team to have played in every FIFA World Cup since the tournament began in 1930.
The highest-scoring international match on record was AS Adema 149-0 SO l'Emyrne in Madagascar in 2002 (own goals scored in protest).
Pele scored over 1,000 career goals according to his own count, including unofficial friendlies.
The FIFA World Cup trophy is made of solid 18-karat gold and weighs about 6.1 kg.
Lionel Messi has won the Ballon d'Or more times than any other player in history.
Real Madrid has won more UEFA Champions League / European Cup titles than any other club.
The fastest goal ever scored in a top-flight match is credited to Nawaf Al-Abed at around 2 seconds.
The first World Cup was held in Uruguay in 1930 and was won by the hosts.
Goal-line technology was first used in the FIFA World Cup in 2014, in Brazil.
VAR (Video Assistant Referee) was used at a World Cup for the first time in Russia 2018.
Manchester United, Liverpool and Arsenal each have storied histories, but only Arsenal has gone an entire Premier League season unbeaten (the 'Invincibles' of 2003-04).
The Old Firm derby between Celtic and Rangers is one of the oldest and fiercest rivalries in football.
Football is the most popular sport in the world, with an estimated 4 billion fans globally.
The Maracana stadium in Brazil set an attendance record of nearly 200,000 spectators in the 1950 World Cup final.
The yellow and red card system was introduced at the 1970 World Cup in Mexico.
Cristiano Ronaldo is the all-time top scorer in men's international football.
The first-ever penalty kick was awarded in 1891 after the rule was introduced.
El Clasico between Real Madrid and Barcelona is the most-watched club match in the world.
Boca Juniors and River Plate share the Superclasico, one of the most intense derbies on the planet.
Diego Maradona's 'Hand of God' goal against England in 1986 is one of football's most controversial moments.
The Bundesliga has the highest average attendance of any football league in the world.
Football was originally banned in England several times in the Middle Ages because it distracted men from archery practice.
Substitutions were not allowed in the World Cup until 1970.
Spain's tiki-taka style won them three consecutive major tournaments: Euro 2008, World Cup 2010, and Euro 2012.
